title: finding(plugin-dashboard): on the editable dashboard-grid, a provider:'object' table or pivot widget never fetches (data: [] plus an objectName neither renderer reads)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it. The site is `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardGridLayout.tsx`, specifically the `table` and `pivot` family arms of the widget-to-node mapping.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the `out_of_scope_findings` (class a) of the objectui#7353 dev report, measured with a real render on base `660d31185`. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

A dashboard widget whose data is `{ provider: 'object', object: … }` renders differently depending on which dashboard renderer draws it.

- **`DashboardRenderer`** (the read dashboard) fetches the object's rows and draws them.
- **`DashboardGridLayout`** (the editable `dashboard-grid`) maps the same widget to one of two nodes, both with `data: []` and `objectName: widgetData.object`:
  - the table family maps to `{ type: 'data-table', …, objectName, data: [] }`;
  - the pivot family maps to `{ type: 'pivot', …, objectName, data: [] }`.

  Neither `DataTableRenderer` nor `PivotTable` reads `objectName`, so the widget draws an empty table or pivot and issues no query.

The code comment on both arms says "pass through object config for async data loading", but nothing downstream loads. `DashboardRenderer`'s own pivot-arm comment calls these grid branches live.

## Reproduction

These are the dev's readings on base `660d31185`, from a one-off probe that was not committed. ⚠️ The seat did not re-run the probe. It did re-read both arms at source on `origin/main`.

- Rendered through the registered `dashboard-grid`, a table widget and a pivot widget with `data: { provider: 'object', object: … }` each read `adapter.find` called **0** times, and the row text was absent.
- The same widget through `DashboardRenderer` fetched and rendered.

## Fix direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Map the object-provider arms to the self-fetching node types `DashboardRenderer` already uses for the same widget (e.g. `object-data-table` / `ObjectPivotTable`), rather than to the static renderers. That way the two dashboard renderers stop diverging on the same metadata.

⚠️ objectui#7353 (PR objectui#10522) removes the `dataProvider` key that these arms also write. Land or rebase on it first.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (the search API answers 403 here), oldest updated 2026-09-18T11:19Z.
- Pattern `DashboardGridLayout … (provider|object|fetch|empty|blank)` or `dashboard-grid … (fetch|empty|blank|never)` ⇒ 2 hits: objectui#7353 and PR objectui#10522, the origin.
- Lit control `DashboardGridLayout` ⇒ 3 hits.

⇒ No duplicate.
